appearances.title: Omarchy agents panel adds automatic switching between Claude, Codex and Grok accounts near a usage limit
appearances.summary: Omarchy's agent tooling can register a second Claude account and switch new sessions to the account with the most room left once usage reaches a set threshold (90% in the example), keeping the current session running. It works for Codex and Grok as well, and the README is in the repo.

appearances.summary: The Omarchy Linux installer now detects the exact laptop model and applies a matching fix (keyboard, Wi-Fi, touchpad and similar), with 52 hardware checks; the fixes are in the open source tree.
